tags.feature: A brand new lab level, much bigger and more challenging than the old one
Features the new props mentioned below to create some new interesting level design
Also added some new furniture
Sentry Gun: an automated turret that shoots the player when you enter its 360 degree line of sight
Explosive Barrels: shoot them or hit them to make them explode
Bullet Shooting Traps: stops the player and enemies walking through them

tags.balance_change: Sounds no longer instantly aggro enemies, they get aggroed after a short delay
Stand guard enemies go back to scanning even when alerted
Improved the laser and night vision goggles visually on the Sniper enemy
Improved performance of Enemy line of sight checks
Reduced nav agent radius to reduce traffic jams

Created gibs system: when enemies are killed by explosions they explode into gibs

tags.balance_change: Improved telefrag power: increased power cost, now grants slomo on use proportional to the number of enemies you stunned

tags.feature: Added Post Processing effects for slomo

tags.balance_change: Lowered slomo transition speed so that leaving slomo is smoother
Improved Mana Orbs: no longer bounce into each other, no longer cause lag spikes

tags.feature: Added hair trigger attribute for some guns: allows you to shoot the (semi auto) gun as fast as you can click (player only, not for enemies)

notes.title: Pre-Early Access Build 0
notes.content:
I've started working towards an Early Access build.

[h1]Changes:[/h1]

[h2]Enemy AI Improvements:[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed and improved how Enemies checks corners: checks both corners when walking through doorways while aggroed
[*] When aggroed by a sound and pursuing, Enemy briefly looks in the sound's direction before looking in direction of path
[*] Fixed the Enemy's alertness level decaying when it shouldn't (before reaching Player's last known location)[/list]

[h2]Started adding in SteamWorks functionality:[/h2]
This doesn't do anything at the moment, just connects to Steam API. Laying the groundwork for workshop, stats, achievements etc.

[h2]Added Main Menu Ambience Sound:[/h2]
Also laying the groundwork for music and other sound like ambience. Future Pre-EA builds will have more work on the audio

[h2]Level Editor:[/h2]
Fixed bug in Level Editor where wall colliders would linger after deleting walls

[*] Fixed the Enemy's alertness level decaying when it shouldn't (before reaching Player's last known location)

notes.title: New Mansion Level
notes.content:
[h2]New Mansion Level[/h2]
[list]
[*]New and improved mansion assets (furniture, walls, floors, doors etc), new mansion enemy designs, new level design
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]Doors now can be facing all 4 directions (they used to only have the hinge on the left for horizontal doors, and the top for vertical doors). This allows for double doors and better level design
[*]Adjusted existing levels to make use of the new door directions
[*]Player's gun no longer clips inside walls (try walking towards wall with gun)
[*]Enemies now only use flanking behaviour when they're alerted (orange or red excalamation mark), no longer flank when just patrolling
[*]Adjusted AI search behaviour (how enemies search when aggroed). Should have better performance
[*]Level Editor: added option to show/debug AI search behaviour during testing
[*]Adjusted Ninja special Enemy: new animations, faster move speed when searching
[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*]Main Menu screen: added animation when navigating to level select screen after clicking start
[*]Level Select screen: now shows challenge levels and your level editor levels in separate tabs
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Blink Power: fixed being unable to blink when hugging a wall above the player
[*]Blink Power: fixed being able to blink out of bounds
[*]Fixed Enemies facing wrong direction for a little bit when starting a level
[/list]

notes.title: Demo: Controller Support, New Level, New Power
notes.content:
[b][u][h1]Major Changes[/h1][/u][/b]
[b][u]Controller Support[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] This might need a little work and tuning.  If you use a gamepad lemme know what you think
[/list]
[b][u]New Telefrag Power[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Right click on an enemy to instantly teleport to them and kill them
[*] Stuns nearby enemies and pulls them towards you
[*] Can teleport through walls
[/list]
[b][u]New Challenge Level[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Challenge level focused on the telefrag power
[/list]

[b][u][h1]Also:[/h1][/u][/b]

[b][u]General[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Improved enemy stun animation
[*] New Input Prompts (images that show a key/button e.g. "Press F to pay respects")
[*] Can now navigate menus with Gamepad, as well as arrow keys on keyboard
[*] Added Gibs system. This is only used in telefrag power atm but could be used elsewhere
[*] Adjusted blood spatter code to be more customisable
[/list]

[b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some powers not working (not sure how long this was broken but it affected Bullet Shield, Stealth Shield and Time Dilation. These powers are currently unused in the campaign, level editor only)
[*] Fixed Lightning preview bug (wouldn't draw the lines that show which enemies get zapped correctly)
[*] Fixed visual bug with mana bar not refilling properly
[/list]

notes.title: Demo: New Level, gameplay changes and more!
notes.content:
[b][u]New Level: Nightclub[/u][/b]
Overhauled the nightclub art assets and created an entirely new nightclub level, the old one from a few builds ago was pretty awful

[u][b]Enemies now drop Mana[/b][/u]
Enemies drop 2 mana orbs when dying, get close enough to it to pick it up

[u][b]Other Changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] VSync: Added VSync option to the options menu. Should fix screen tearing if you get that issue
[*] Ammo check when going to next stage: If you move to next stage with less than 1 mag of ammo, you'll be given enough ammo to have 1 mag. Necessary to prevent softlocks in some cases
[*] Increased ammo pickup distance for all weapons. All weapons now have the same pickup distance (used to be smaller for visually smaller weapons e.g. pistols)
[*] Lightning Power: Aiming lightning shows a preview of which enemies will be zapped. Try Museum level to see this in action
[*] Level Editor Camera keeps the same position and zoom level when moving between play testing and level editing
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed vertical doors not being able to knock, and not closing correctly
[*] Fixed visual bug with the "R to restart" screen flickering sometimes
[*] Fixed visual bug with the "R to restart" screen where the reticle would show above the menu
[*] Fixed bug with alt tabbing, where alt tabbing would unpause the game without player input and without hiding the pause menu, and the timescale going all weird
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Build 06/04/2023 - Rebindable Controls + more
notes.content:
New Input + Rebindable Controls:  Main/Pause Menu -> Options button
- Controls should show correctly in the UI (except showing mouse button isn't properly set up yet)
- Menus might look a bit janky but it should all work. I think I'm gonna scrap the secondary column, but keep the preset buttons (left handed player presets are OKL;  , Arrow Keys and Numpad)
- Currently you can have multiple actions bound to the same key, will be fixed later

Level Editor:
- Added Playtest only cheats: Godmode, noclip and invisibility (top right by the playtest button)
- Floor Tool X/Y offset option for pattern mode to allow placing patterns correctly where you want them
- Fixed Level Options > Stage Order bug keeping deleted Stages
- Hotkeys are now in line with the rebindable controls, will need to add in some kind of menu to show these
